definitions.explanation: Experiencing or doing something for the first time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{初|はじ}めて⟦{来|き}ました→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I came to Japan for the first time.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧
⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{初|はじ}めて⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate sushi for the first time.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んだ→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: The child who saw snow for the first time was very happy.

examples.japanese: {初|はじ}めて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{海外旅行|かいがいりょこう}→海外旅行：24321_kaigairyokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{何|なに}もかも→何もかも：26777_nanimokamo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}に→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧⟦{感|かん}じられた→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: On my first trip abroad, everything felt fresh and new.

notes:
{初|はじ}めて is an adverb meaning 'for the first time.' It indicates the speaker's first experience of something.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {初|はじ}めて + verb: {初|はじ}めて⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ (ate for the first time)
- {初|はじ}めての + noun: {初|はじ}めての⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ (first experience), {初|はじ}めての⟦デート→デート：03861_deeto⟧ (first date)
- Verb て-form + {初|はじ}めて: ⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧{初|はじ}めて⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ (only after coming did I understand)

GREETING:
⟦{初|はじ}めまして→初めまして：00934_hajimemashite⟧ (Nice to meet you) derives from this word. Used when meeting someone for the first time.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}に→最初：00882_saisho⟧: first (in a sequence), initially
- {初|はじ}めて: for the first time (emphasizes newness of experience)

USAGE:
Do not confuse with ⟦{始|はじ}めて→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧ from {始|はじ}める (to begin). {初|はじ}めて uses the kanji {初|はつ} (first/new).
